svg.title: How Spead AI Pro for WIKA is built
svg.desc: People: Tender and legal, Platform admin. App: Web app, Document editor. Services: API, PDF and email workers, Employee assistants. Data & AI: PostgreSQL, Encrypted storage, LLM provider, Connectors. Linux server with systemd and nginx behind a CDN, daily encrypted backups, and migrations tested on a copy before each release.
svg.text: The main parts and how data moves between them.
